Each indicator is encoded -1 (phishing-like), 0 (neutral / suspicious) or 1 (legitimate-like). The model also uses two derived features, the number of indicators equal to -1 and to 0, which this app computes automatically.

Class -1 = phishing, class 1 = legitimate. The verdict is the average of all 100 trees' leaf probabilities.

Browsers can't do DNS, WHOIS or certificate lookups, so URL auto-fill only covers IP-in-URL, dash in domain, sub-domains and HTTPS. Set the rest manually. This is a decision aid, not a guarantee.
